notes.title: New Patch - 1.7
notes.notes:
In addition to the latest DLC, a new patch has been released! 


 An audio latency adjustment screen has been added to the Boom Shack
 Performance improvements
 Changes to Boom Shack menu to accommodate newly-released DLC
 An unlockable Golden Ziggs costume has been added for all players

notes.title: Patch v1.1 - Live Now
notes.notes:
Option to rebind controls for Controller, Mouse, and Keyboard has been implemented
 Issue with text disappearing in certain languages is now fixed

notes.title: Patch v1.1 - Update
notes.notes: We've come to the conclusion that Patch v1.1 has created some issue with gameplay. We are actively working to correct this. For now, we are rolling back this patch and will release a proper one next week. Thank you for your continued patience!
